# Snex v0.4.2 - Table of Contents

🐍 Easy and efficient Python interop for Elixir

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://snex.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [License](https://snex.hexdocs.pm/license.md)
- [ Notice](https://snex.hexdocs.pm/notice.md)

## Modules

- [Python_Interface_Documentation](https://snex.hexdocs.pm/Python_Interface_Documentation.md): Documentation for Python `snex` module.
- [Snex](https://snex.hexdocs.pm/Snex.md): Easy and efficient Python interop for Elixir.
- [Snex.Application](https://snex.hexdocs.pm/Snex.Application.md): The Snex application.
- [Snex.Code](https://snex.hexdocs.pm/Snex.Code.md): Struct representing a Python code snippet.
- [Snex.Env](https://snex.hexdocs.pm/Snex.Env.md): An environment (`%Snex.Env{}`) is an Elixir-side reference to a Python-side variable context
in which the Python code is executed.
- [Snex.Interpreter](https://snex.hexdocs.pm/Snex.Interpreter.md): Runs a Python interpreter in a separate OS process.
- [Snex.Release](https://snex.hexdocs.pm/Snex.Release.md): Snex puts its managed files under `_build/$MIX_ENV/snex`.
This works out of the box with `iex -S mix` and other local ways of running your code,
but requires an additional step to copy files around to prepare your releases.
- [Snex.Serde](https://snex.hexdocs.pm/Snex.Serde.md): Serialization and deserialization between Elixir and Python.
- [Snex.Serde.Encoder](https://snex.hexdocs.pm/Snex.Serde.Encoder.md): Protocol for custom encoding of Elixir terms to a desired representation on the Python side
used by `Snex.Serde`.
- [Snex.Sigils](https://snex.hexdocs.pm/Snex.Sigils.md): Sigils for creating `Snex.Code` structs.

- Exceptions
  - [Snex.Error](https://snex.hexdocs.pm/Snex.Error.md): Domain-specific errors returned by `Snex`.
